# tebib_vpc (Data Source)

Looks up a VPC by ID, by name, or the project's default VPC (`default = true`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tebib_vpc" "default" {
  default = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Look up the default VPC (every project has one).
- `id` (String) VPC ID.
- `name` (String) Name to look up.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Default: the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 range.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `ipv6_cidr` (String) IPv6 range.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags.
- `trn` (String) TRN.
